units.source_text: 且说源氏觉得这封信很奇怪，乘人不见的时候，拿出来反复观看。

en.t: Genji thought this letter was very strange, and when no one was watching, he took it out and read it over and over.

units.source_text: 他疑心这是三公主身边的侍女模仿柏木笔迹而戏书的。

en.t: He suspected that one of the Third Princess's attendants had imitated Kashiwagi's handwriting and written it as a joke.

units.source_text: 然而信中词藻富丽，有些地方决非他人所能模拟。

en.t: Yet the language in the letter was so rich and elegant that some passages could never have been imitated by anyone else.

units.source_text: 信中叙述长年刻骨相思，痛苦不可言喻。

en.t: The letter described years of love that had cut to the bone, and suffering beyond words.

units.source_text: 一旦夙愿既遂，反而更增烦恼。

en.t: Once his long-cherished wish had been fulfilled, his anguish had only grown greater.

units.source_text: 措词非常高明，令人真心感动。

en.t: The wording was extremely skillful and genuinely moving.

units.source_text: 但源氏想道：“这种事情，岂可如此明白地形诸笔墨呢！

en.t: But Genji thought, "How could anyone put such a matter so plainly into writing?

units.source_text: 只有柏木这种人才会不识轻重地写在信上。

en.t: Only someone like Kashiwagi would be so reckless as to write it in a letter.

units.source_text: 回想自己从前写情书时，深恐落入他人之手，故即使要写此种细情，亦必略去隐事，措词暧昧。

en.t: When I think back to the love letters I once wrote, I was terrified they might fall into another person's hands, so even when I had to write of such intimate feelings, I left out hidden matters and kept the wording ambiguous.

units.source_text: 如此看来，一个人要能深思远虑，不是容易之事。”

en.t: Seen in this way, it is no easy thing for a person to think deeply and look far ahead."

units.source_text: 便连柏木的智力也看不起了。

en.t: He even began to look down on Kashiwagi's intelligence.

units.source_text: 接着又想：“事已如此，教我今后怎样对待这位公主呢？

en.t: Then he thought again, "Now that things have come to this, how am I to treat this princess from now on?

units.source_text: 可知她的怀孕，正是此事的结果。

en.t: It is clear that her pregnancy is the result of this affair.

units.source_text: 哎呀！

en.t: Ah!

units.source_text: 真正气死我也！

en.t: It truly enrages me beyond endurance!

units.source_text: 这件痛心之事，不是听人传说，却是我亲自看出，难道还能同从前一样地爱护她么？”

en.t: This heartbreaking matter was not something I heard from others; I saw it for myself, so how could I still cherish her as I did before?"

units.source_text: 他扪心自问，觉得无论如何不能回心转意。

en.t: He searched his own heart and felt that, no matter what, he could not change his mind.

units.source_text: 又想：“即使是逢场作戏，对这女子初无爱情，但倘闻知其人另有所欢，亦必发生不快之感与嫌恶之心。

en.t: He thought further, "Even if it were only a casual dalliance and there had been no love for the woman at first, learning that she had another lover would still bring feelings of displeasure and disgust.

units.source_text: 何况此人身份特殊，竟有不知自量之人，胆敢相犯！

en.t: How much more so when this woman has a special rank, and some man who does not know his place has dared to violate it!

units.source_text: 私通皇帝之妻，古昔亦有其例，但这又作别论。

en.t: There have been cases in ancient times of men having illicit relations with an emperor's wife, but that is another matter.

units.source_text: 因为在宫中，后妃与百官共事一主，其间自有种种机缘互相见面，互相倾心，因而发生暧昧之事，其例不在少数。

en.t: In the palace, consorts and officials serve the same sovereign, and there are naturally many occasions for them to meet, become drawn to one another, and fall into ambiguous affairs; such examples are not rare.

units.source_text: 即使是身份高贵的女御与更衣，亦有在某点上或某方面缺乏教养之人，其中又必有轻狂浮薄的女子，因此也会发生意外之事。

en.t: Even among high-ranking court ladies such as nyogo and koi, some may lack refinement in some respect, and among them there are bound to be frivolous women, so unexpected incidents can occur.

units.source_text: 而在隐约模糊、不露痕迹的期间，其人照旧可在宫中服务，背人偷做苟且之事。

en.t: While everything remains vague and leaves no trace, such a woman can continue serving in the palace as usual while secretly committing improprieties out of sight.

units.source_text: 但现在这件事情况不同：她是我家至高无上的夫人，我对待她，比我所心爱的紫夫人更加优厚，更加尊重。

en.t: But the present case is different: she is the highest lady of my household, and I have treated her more generously and with greater respect than even my beloved Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 她却撇开了我而干这种勾当，真乃从来未有之事。”

en.t: Yet she set me aside and did such a thing; it is truly unheard of."

units.source_text: 他对三公主大为不满。

en.t: He felt deep resentment toward the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 继而又想：“又如有一女子，虽然是皇帝的妃嫔，但只当一个普通宫人，并不特别承宠，一向屈居人下。

en.t: Then he thought again, "Suppose there is a woman who, though she is one of the emperor's consorts, is treated only as an ordinary palace woman, receives no special favor, and has always lived beneath others.

units.source_text: 这女子和另一男子结了深情重爱，两人心心相印。

en.t: This woman forms a deep and passionate bond with another man, and the two understand one another completely.

units.source_text: 男的来信，女的免不了常常作答，于是两人的关系自然密切起来。

en.t: When the man sends letters, the woman inevitably answers often, and in this way their relationship naturally grows close.

units.source_text: 此种行径虽然也很荒唐，但是情犹可原。

en.t: Such conduct is certainly absurd, but emotionally it can still be excused.

units.source_text: 至于像我这个人，竟会被柏木这小子分去妻子的爱，真乃意想不到之事！”

en.t: But for someone like me to have my wife's love taken away by a fellow like Kashiwagi is truly beyond anything I could have imagined!"

units.source_text: 他心中异常不快。

en.t: His heart was filled with extraordinary bitterness.

units.source_text: 然而此事又是不可使外人知道的，只得闷在心里。

en.t: Yet this matter could not be allowed to become known to outsiders, so he could only keep it shut up in his heart.

units.source_text: 最后想道：“推想桐壶父皇当年，恐怕心里也明明知道我与藤壶母后之事，然而面子上只装作不知。

en.t: At last he thought, "Thinking back, my father Kiritsubo must surely have known in his heart about what happened between me and Mother Fujitsubo, yet outwardly he only pretended not to know.

units.source_text: 回思当时之事，可怕之极，真是大逆不道的罪恶啊！”

en.t: When I recall those days, it is utterly terrifying; it was truly a crime of the deepest disloyalty and impiety!"

units.source_text: 他想到了自己的例子，便觉得“恋爱山”里的事情是不可非难的。

en.t: When he thought of his own example, he felt that the affair in "The Mountain of Love" could not be condemned.
